question: What was our net revenue in USD in EMEA for Q3 2026?

input.purpose: Inspect billing headers for Q3 2026 by currency and billing type to understand net revenue fields.
input.sql: SELECT fkart, waerk, count(*) AS n, sum(CAST(netwr AS DECIMAL(18,2))) AS netwr_sum, min(fkdat) AS min_d, max(fkdat) AS max_d FROM sap_s4.vbrk WHERE _fivetran_deleted = false GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

input.purpose: Check exchange rate table structure and available rate types and currencies.
input.sql: SELECT kurst, fcurr, tcurr, count(*) AS n, min(gdatu) AS min_g, max(gdatu) AS max_g FROM sap_s4.tcurr WHERE _fivetran_deleted = false GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2,3

input.purpose: See how customers are assigned to countries and check the sales orgs used, to define EMEA.
input.sql: SELECT k.land_1, count(*) AS customers FROM sap_s4.kna_1 k WHERE k._fivetran_deleted = false GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

input.purpose: View all EUR-to-USD rate rows with the reversed date key to decode valid-from dates.
input.sql: SELECT kurst, fcurr, tcurr, gdatu, CAST(99999999 - CAST(gdatu AS INT) AS VARCHAR) AS valid_from_decoded, ukurs, aedat, _fivetran_deleted FROM sap_s4.tcurr ORDER BY gdatu

input.purpose: Look at Salesforce account region and country fields alongside SAP customer numbers to define EMEA.
input.sql: SELECT region_c, billing_country, count(*) AS n, count(sap_customer_number_c) AS with_sap FROM salesforce.account WHERE _fivetran_active = true AND _fivetran_deleted = false GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

input.purpose: Check SAP customer master country list in full, including deleted flags, and the billing customer link.
input.sql: SELECT land_1, ktokd, count(*) AS n, sum(CASE WHEN _fivetran_deleted THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS deleted_n FROM sap_s4.kna_1 GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

input.purpose: Check duplicates in billing headers and whether credit memos (G2) carry negative amounts; also check billing-to-customer link coverage.
input.sql: SELECT b.fkart, b.waerk, count(*) AS rows_n, count(DISTINCT b.vbeln) AS distinct_vbeln, sum(CASE WHEN CAST(b.netwr AS DECIMAL(18,2))<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS neg_rows, sum(CASE WHEN k.kunnr IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_customer_match, sum(CASE WHEN b.fkdat BETWEEN '20260701' AND '20260930' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS q3_rows FROM sap_s4.vbrk b LEFT JOIN sap_s4.kna_1 k ON k.kunnr=b.kunag AND k._fivetran_deleted=false WHERE b._fivetran_deleted=false GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

input.purpose: Check billing item table for Q3 invoices and whether header totals agree with item totals (cross-check on the header netwr).
input.sql: SELECT h.fkart, h.waerk, count(*) AS hdr_n, sum(CAST(h.netwr AS DECIMAL(18,2))) AS hdr_netwr, (SELECT count(*) FROM sap_s4.vbrp p WHERE p.vbeln IN (SELECT vbeln FROM sap_s4.vbrk x WHERE x.fkart=h.fkart AND x.waerk=h.waerk AND x._fivetran_deleted=false AND x.fkdat BETWEEN '20260701' AND '20260930') AND p._fivetran_deleted=false) AS item_rows_q3 FROM sap_s4.vbrk h WHERE h._fivetran_deleted=false AND h.fkdat BETWEEN '20260701' AND '20260930' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

input.purpose: Compute Q3 2026 EMEA net revenue in USD: invoices minus credit memos, EUR converted at the monthly M-rate valid for each billing date.
input.sql:
WITH rates AS (
  SELECT CAST(99999999 - CAST(gdatu AS INT) AS VARCHAR) AS valid_from, CAST(ukurs AS DECIMAL(12,5)) AS rate
  FROM sap_s4.tcurr WHERE kurst='M' AND fcurr='EUR' AND tcurr='USD' AND _fivetran_deleted=false
),
bill AS (
  SELECT b.vbeln, b.fkart, b.fkdat, b.waerk, CAST(b.netwr AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS netwr, k.land_1
  FROM sap_s4.vbrk b
  JOIN sap_s4.kna_1 k ON k.kunnr=b.kunag AND k._fivetran_deleted=false
  WHERE b._fivetran_deleted=false AND b.fkdat BETWEEN '20260701' AND '20260930'
    AND k.land_1 IN ('AT','DE','FR','GB','IT','NL','SE')
),
conv AS (
  SELECT bl.*,
    CASE WHEN bl.waerk='USD' THEN 1.0 ELSE (SELECT r.rate FROM rates r WHERE r.valid_from <= bl.fkdat ORDER BY r.valid_from DESC LIMIT 1) END AS fx,
    CASE WHEN bl.fkart='G2' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END AS sign
  FROM bill bl
)
SELECT fkart, waerk, count(*) AS docs, sum(netwr) AS local_amt, sum(netwr*fx*sign) AS usd_net
FROM conv GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2"

auto_fixed: removed a stray trailing double quote

input.purpose: Cross-check Q3 EMEA net revenue at the item level (vbrp) against header totals, excluding deleted items.
input.sql: SELECT b.fkart, b.waerk, count(*) AS items, sum(CAST(p.netwr AS DECIMAL(18,2))) AS item_netwr_local FROM sap_s4.vbrp p JOIN sap_s4.vbrk b ON b.vbeln=p.vbeln AND b._fivetran_deleted=false JOIN sap_s4.kna_1 k ON k.kunnr=b.kunag AND k._fivetran_deleted=false WHERE p._fivetran_deleted=false AND b.fkdat BETWEEN '20260701' AND '20260930' AND k.land_1 IN ('AT','DE','FR','GB','IT','NL','SE') GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

answer.answer_summary: Torvane's Q3 2026 net revenue in EMEA was about $5.79M USD ($5,789,489), after subtracting credit memos. That is $5.82M of invoices less $29.6K of credit memos, with EUR amounts converted at each month's SAP EUR→USD rate. All EMEA billing in Q3 was in EUR.

metrics_used.name: Net revenue (EMEA, Q3 2026, USD)
metrics_used.definition: Sum of SAP billing document net value (vbrk.netwr) for invoices (fkart F2) minus credit memos (fkart G2), billing dates 1 Jul to 30 Sep 2026, for customers whose SAP country (kna_1.land_1) is in EMEA (AT, DE, FR, GB, IT, NL, SE). EUR amounts converted to USD at the SAP M-type monthly rate valid for each billing date.

lineage: sap_s4.vbrk + sap_s4.kna_1 (EMEA country filter) + sap_s4.tcurr (M-type EUR→USD) -> Q3 EMEA net revenue (USD)
sap_s4.vbrp cross-check: item-level net value equals header net value for Q3 EMEA
assumptions: EMEA is defined by the SAP customer's country: AT, DE, FR, GB, IT, NL, SE. This matches the Salesforce EMEA region exactly.
Revenue is recognized on the billing date (vbrk.fkdat), so Q3 is 1 Jul to 30 Sep 2026 inclusive.
Net revenue = invoices (F2) minus credit memos (G2). Credit memos are stored as positive amounts, so they are subtracted.
EUR is converted to USD at the SAP M-type (average) rate for the month of each billing date: Jul 1.05674, Aug 1.05844, Sep 1.04521.
Net value (netwr) is used, which excludes tax.
No cancelled-invoice flag was found in the data, so none was excluded.
caveats: Converting at a single rate would move the total. Converting all Q3 EUR at the September rate gives about $5.74M, a difference of roughly $48K.
Figures come from SAP billing data only. I did not reconcile to the general ledger or to any finance-reported revenue figure.
I did not check the sync timestamps for the source tables, so data freshness is unverified. The latest billing document date in the data is 6 Nov 2026.
